scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "pnpm --filter backend dev" "pnpm --filter frontend dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter backend build && pnpm --filter frontend build
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck
scripts.sync: git switch main && git pull && pnpm install
scripts.sync:branch: git fetch origin && git merge --no-commit origin/main && pnpm install
